text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Senpai, we have a crisis! Gold Ship is 
going around plastering her handmade 
stickers all over the academy!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What did you say!? Pulling another stupid 
prank...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-hmmm~♪ Perfect! Now once someone 
peeks into that tree stump――

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Behold Golshi-chan's funny face sticker! 
And just like that, the world smiles once 
again☆

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: There you are, Gold Ship!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Geh, Air Groove! Talk about a hassle 
showing up... It's tough being this 
popular!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hold it right there! Gold Shiiip—!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
As the genius Dr. Golstein says: time and 
Golshi-chan wait for no one!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Aargh, spouting nothing but nonsense...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare underestimate me, Gold 
Ship!!

Air Groove forcefully overtook Gold Ship 
on the outside and blocked her path ahead.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold up! What was that run just 
now?! You were so sharp! Got any tips or 
what?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but I do... Your provocation is what 
awakened me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ummm... Could it be that she's pretty mad?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, who knows? Either way, we'll find 
out soon enough. Come to the student 
council room.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Gold Ship seems to have reflected on 
her actions, and you've managed to 
discover a new strength.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Indeed, all problems solved!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, I certainly hope he's truly 
reflecting on his actions, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Still, homemade stickers, huh... 
Stickers... 'stick' to it... wait.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Follow the seals to discover your own 
true strength!" What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Um... that was magnificent.

From this day on, Air Groove's running 
gained even greater sharpness.
